newsitem.title: USA: Bugher named to replace top aide to Wis. governor.
newsitem.headline: Bugher named to replace top aide to Wis. governor.

text.p: Mark Bugher has been tapped to succeed James Klauser as the top aide to Wisconsin Gov. Tommy Thompson.

Thompson announced last week that Bugher, current secretary of the state's revenue department, will replace Klauser who plans to resign his position as secretary of the department of administration on Dec. 6.
Klauser, who has held that position since 1987, has been in charge of the state's budget and bond issuance and has been a member of state boards, commissions and committees.
Bugher has been with the Thompson Administration since 1987, first as an executive assistant in the revenue department, then as secretary beginning in 1988.
